name: discover-accounts-enterprise-icp
description: Enterprise-scale ICP should return F500-class real companies, not startups.

businessContext.overview: Enterprise identity governance for Fortune 500 IT organizations.

icp.title: CISO / VP IAM at Fortune 500 regulated enterprises
icp.description: Global enterprises with 10,000+ employees in regulated industries.
buyingSignals: Migration from Active Directory to cloud IDP

expectations.rubric: Accounts should reasonably be large enterprises (10,000+ employees) in insurance, banking, or healthcare — think Anthem, Allianz, JPMorgan, HCA Healthcare, UnitedHealth, Prudential, Cigna, etc. Score low if the list includes obvious SMB or Series A companies.
